ticket.summary: Members earn loyalty points at checkout

criteria.text: Members earn 1 point per whole dollar of the order subtotal for orders from $10.00 to $500.00 inclusive. Orders below $10.00 earn no points, and orders above $500.00 earn 500 points.

techniques.reason: A points range on the subtotal, $10.00 to $500.00 inclusive, with different outcomes either side of each limit.
Three classes with three outcomes: no points below $10.00, 1 per whole dollar within, a cap of 500 above $500.00.

criteria.text: Gold members earn double points and Silver members earn 1.5 times the points, rounded down; Bronze members earn the base points. When the DOUBLEUP promotion is active, every tier earns 1 extra point per whole dollar, but the promotion never applies to an order paid entirely with a gift card.

techniques.reason: The points depend on three conditions together: the tier, whether DOUBLEUP is active, and whether a gift card paid the whole order (which switches the promotion off).

criteria.text: Points are pending when the order is placed, become available when it is delivered, and are removed if the order is cancelled before it ships or returned after delivery. A shipped order can't be cancelled.

techniques.reason: Points follow the order's lifecycle (placed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned), and one transition is forbidden (cancelling a shipped order).

criteria.text: Points are earned with every payment method (card, PayPal, gift card), every delivery option (standard, express, click and collect) and every member tier (Gold, Silver, Bronze).

techniques.reason: Three independent parameters of three values each (27 combinations); all pairs of values are covered by 10 orders (greedy all-pairs).

criteria.text: The points balance on the account page updates promptly after delivery.

techniques.reason: One observable flow (deliver an order, then look at the account page); the timing has no number yet, so the case depends on Q-1.

questions.question: "Promptly" needs a number and a unit: within how many seconds or minutes of delivery must the balance show the new points?
Is the DOUBLEUP extra point added after the tier multiplier (Gold: 2 + 1 = 3 points per dollar) or multiplied by it (Gold: 2 x (1 + 1) = 4)? The cases assume added after.

limitations: The cases were designed from the ticket alone; no running shop was used, so the screens and messages named in the steps are as the ticket and the comment describe them.
Cases for the DOUBLEUP rows assume the extra point is added after the tier multiplier (Q-2); if the answer is the other reading, those 3 cases change their expected points.
The balance timing in AC-5 has no number yet (Q-1); its case can be run, but not passed or failed, until it is answered.
Pairwise covers every pair of payment, delivery and tier, not every triple (27 combinations, 10 cases).
